diffSummary: Temporary-password sessions are blocked from every business route until password change completes.
Auth restore, logout and change-password remain available to restricted sessions.
The web app presents a non-bypassable first-sign-in password-change gate.
Password reuse is rejected by both UI validation and the API.
Operators no longer see the manager/admin-only local-v5 migration entry.
rationale: Make the temporary-password policy and migration permissions enforceable at the server boundary, not only by UI convention.
